THE PREVIOUS README.qmd file (for step 3)
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(fs)

# 1. One row per YEAR for now (not per abstract yet)
yearly <- tibble(file_path = dir_ls("data/abstracts", recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.txt")) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(path_file(path_dir(file_path))),   # folder name = year
    meeting_title = path_file(file_path) %>% str_remove("\\.pdf\\.txt$"),
    text = map_chr(file_path, read_file)
  )

nrow(yearly)        # should be 17
yearly$year
```

```{r}
yearly <- yearly %>%
  mutate(location = str_match(meeting_title, "\\(([^)]+)\\)")[,2] %>%
           str_remove("\\s*-\\s*\\d{4}$"))
```

define regex
```{r}
split_pattern <- "\\n(?=[\\p{L}][\\p{L}'’.\\-]{1,30}+(?:\\s[\\p{L}][\\p{L}'’.\\-]{0,20}+){0,3}+,\\s(?:[\\p{L}][\\p{L}'’.\\-]{0,15}+\\.?+\\s*+){1,3}+[\\(\\[])"

header_pattern <- "ABSTRACTS OF THE SAA \\d+(ST|ND|RD|TH) ANNUAL MEETING\\s*\\d*"

```

custom stops
```{r}
custom_stops <- tibble(word = c("paper", "presentation", "discusses", "abstract", "data", "de", "la", "el", "los", "las", "del", "en", "censored"))
```


## function for parsing abstract
```{r}
split_and_parse <- function(text, yr) {
  records <- str_split(paste0("\n", text), split_pattern)[[1]] %>%
    str_trim() %>% discard(~ nchar(.x) == 0)
  
  tibble(raw = records) %>%
    mutate(block_id = row_number(),
           entry = str_split(raw, "(?=\\[\\d{1,5}\\])")) %>%
    unnest(entry) %>%
    group_by(block_id) %>%
    mutate(author_block = first(entry)) %>%
    filter(str_detect(entry, "^\\[\\d{1,5}\\]")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      abstract_id   = str_extract(entry, "\\d{1,5}"),
      body          = str_remove(entry, "^\\[\\d{1,5}\\]\\s*"),
      is_see_ref    = str_detect(body, "^see\\s"),
      is_discussant = str_detect(body, "^Discussant"),
      body_clean    = str_remove_all(body, header_pattern),
      year = yr
    ) %>%
    filter(!is_see_ref, !is_discussant, nchar(body) > 30) %>%
    mutate(doc_id = paste0(yr, "_", row_number()))
}
```

run for all years
```{r}
all_documents <- map2_dfr(yearly$text, yearly$year, split_and_parse)
nrow(all_documents)   # expect roughly 17x your per-year count, likely 30,000-50,000+
```

## Tokenize, stopword-filter, and count on the combined corpus 
```{r}
all_tokens <- all_documents %>%
  select(doc_id, year, body_clean) %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, body_clean) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words, by = "word") %>%
  anti_join(custom_stops, by = "word") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(word, "^\\d+$"))

all_word_counts <- all_tokens %>% count(doc_id, word, sort = TRUE)
```

## Cast the full-corpus DTM
```{r}
dtm_full <- all_word_counts %>% cast_sparse(row = doc_id, column = word, value = n)
dim(dtm_full)
```
